Offline OCR for "Scan receipt", vendored as plain files (no build step, no network at run time).

tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js   tesseract.js 5.1.1          Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE)
                                  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js
                                  tesseract.js-core 5.1.1     Apache License 2.0 (core/LICENSE)
                                  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
lang/eng.traineddata.gz           @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (4.0.0_best_int)
lang/chi_tra.traineddata.gz       @tesseract.js-data/chi_tra 1.0.0 (4.0.0_best_int)
                                  Tesseract language data, Apache License 2.0
                                  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata

Downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ on 2026-11-15. Only the SIMD + LSTM core is
included (every current browser supports WebAssembly SIMD); without it, the app says the
receipt could not be read and the amount is typed in by hand.
